_readme: Fake customer list for the Reactivation Campaign demo. Names, emails, phone numbers and service history are invented; .example cannot receive mail and the 555 numbers are reserved and unroutable. The ten records are chosen so that every suppression rule and both channels fire on a single run.

business.name: Northgate Auto Care
business.offer: $30 off any service booked before 30 September

customers.sms_consent_source: Signed service intake form, box ticked
customers._demo_note: Expected: SMS. Dormant 8 months, written consent on file, mobile number.

demo_hint.message: Hi Marcus - it's Northgate Auto Care. Your RAV4 is coming up on 9 months since its last full service. We've got $30 off a service booked before 30 September if you'd like it. Reply STOP to opt out.

customers._demo_note: Expected: EMAIL. Dormant 14 months, but no SMS consent on record. A mobile number is not consent.

demo_hint.subject: Your Civic is due a look, Rhiannon
demo_hint.message:
Hi Rhiannon,

It's been about 14 months since we last saw your Civic for an oil change and tyre rotation. Most cars want another one around now.

We're offering $30 off a service booked before 30 September. Reply to this email or call the shop and we'll find you a slot.

Northgate Auto Care

customers.sms_consent_source: Signed service intake form, box ticked
customers._demo_note: Expected: SUPPRESSED. Opted out of marketing. Consent on file does not override an opt-out - the opt-out is the newer instruction.

customers.sms_consent_source: Signed service intake form, box ticked
customers._demo_note: Expected: SUPPRESSED. Serviced three weeks ago. Texting an active customer to ask them to come back is the fastest way to look like you do not know who they are.

customers.sms_consent_source: Signed service intake form, box ticked
customers._demo_note: Expected: SUPPRESSED. On the do-not-contact list after a disputed invoice. High value, and still must not be contacted.
Expected: SUPPRESSED. No usable phone or email. Worth surfacing so someone can go and fix the record.

customers.sms_consent_source: Signed service intake form, box ticked
customers._demo_note: Expected: SUPPRESSED. Already contacted nine days ago. Campaign fatigue is what turns a list into a dead list.

customers.sms_consent_source: Signed service intake form, box ticked
customers._demo_note: Expected: SMS, VIP segment. Dormant 13 months and worth $6,120 in lifetime spend. This is the one the campaign exists for.

demo_hint.message: Hi Bill - Northgate Auto Care here. It's been a while since the F-150's transmission work and we'd like to get you back in for a check-over. $30 off any service booked before 30 September. Reply STOP to opt out.

customers._demo_note: Expected: EMAIL, cold segment. Dormant 27 months. Probably gone, cheap to try by email, never worth a text.

demo_hint.subject: Still got the Sportage, Anneke?
demo_hint.message:
Hi Anneke,

It's been a couple of years since we last saw your Sportage at Northgate Auto Care. If you've still got it and it's due some attention, we're taking $30 off any service booked before 30 September.

And if you've moved on from the car, just let us know and we'll stop emailing.

Northgate Auto Care

customers.sms_consent_source: Signed service intake form, box ticked
customers._demo_note: Expected: EMAIL. Consent is on file, but the number is a landline. Texting it burns money and delivers nothing.

demo_hint.subject: Your Hilux is about due, Ray
demo_hint.message:
Hi Ray,

It's been a year since the Hilux came in for its full service and aircon regas. That's usually about the right interval for another look.

$30 off any service booked before 30 September - reply here or give the shop a ring.

Northgate Auto Care
